先确认电脑端显示“运行中”。手机请用羽连 App 连接，普通浏览器无法打开遥控界: Check that the PC shows “Running”. Connect with the PlumeLink phone app; a regular browser cannot open the remote screen.
手机连上 Wi-Fi，电脑连同一个路由器；电脑用网线也可以。若手机在使用移动数据: Connect your phone to Wi-Fi and the PC to the same router; an Ethernet cable is fine. If the phone is on mobile data, guest Wi-Fi, or a work network, try a normal home Wi-Fi network.
找不到电脑时，点手机上的“重新搜索”，或扫描电脑二维码；也可以手动输入电脑显示的: If the PC is missing, tap “Search again” on the phone, scan the PC’s QR code, or enter the connection address shown on the PC.
扫码仍连不上时，核对电脑上的 6 位配对码；过期后用新码。首次连接出现电脑身份确: If scanning still fails, check the six-digit code on the PC and use the new code if it expired. On the first connection, check the PC address shown in the identity prompt.
如果 Windows 弹出网络访问提示，请允许羽连在“专用网络”中通信。曾拒绝过: If Windows asks about network access, allow PlumeLink on private networks. If you denied it earlier, allow it in Windows Firewall settings.
电脑开着 VPN、同时连了多个网络，或换过 Wi-Fi 后，请到“偏好设置 →: If the PC uses a VPN, has several network connections, or changed Wi-Fi, choose the active network adapter under Preferences → Connection settings and restart remote control.
连接成功却不能操作时，检查设备管理中的遥控权限；电脑锁屏或弹出系统确认窗口时，需: If connected but controls do not work, check the device’s remote-control permission. Unlock the PC or respond to Windows confirmation prompts on the PC.
